name: image-feathered-motion
title: Feathered Motion
description: Editorial portrait with black feathers caught mid-motion

subject.descent: Not asserted — synthetic subject; specify explicitly when recreating.
subject.physical: Long dark hair fanned upward and outward as if suspended; head tilted back, chin raised, shoulders squared to camera
subject.expression: Eyes closed, lips relaxed — serene rather than posed
subject.clothing: Black feathered bodice with dense plumage across the shoulders and chest

composition.depthOfField: Shallow; background falls to soft grey haze
composition.focus: Eyes and the feather edge along the collarbone

framing.subjectScale: Figure spans ~70% of frame width and the full frame height
framing.subjectBox: Head x≈35–65%, y≈18–45%; feathered bodice widens to x≈8–92% by the bottom edge
framing.anchors: Eyeline at ~30% from top; hair plume rises to and past the top edge
framing.edges: Hair exits the top edge; bodice exits the bottom edge; smoke fills both side margins
framing.negativeSpace: No headroom — hair is cut by the frame; ~10% clear margin each side at head height

environment.background: Featureless smoke-grey backdrop with soft tonal falloff, no props

lighting.direction: Broad frontal key slightly above eyeline, gentle fill from below
lighting.shadows: Low-contrast; shadows open and grey, no hard edges

camera.quality: Clean, high-detail, fine grain, matte low-contrast grade

atmosphere.story: A figure caught mid-fall or mid-float, weightless.
atmosphere.micro: Closed eyes and unclenched jaw — calm, not strained
